label: Motorcycle State
description: What the bike is doing: cornering physics, rest, or wrenching.

items.name: knee-down
items.text: heeled hard into a corner, knee slider skimming the apex paint, the tire edge feathered to its last millimeter

items.name: wheelie-exit
items.text: lofting the front wheel out of a corner under power, forks fully extended, rear tire squatting into the tarmac

items.name: kickstand-rest
items.text: parked on its kickstand with the front wheel tipped into the lean, engine cases ticking as they cool

items.name: bench-teardown
items.text: up on a workshop bench mid-service, tank off and wiring exposed, tools laid out in ordered rows

items.name: flat-track-slide
items.text: crossed up in a flat-track slide, handlebars at opposite lock, the rear wheel spinning a rooster tail of dirt

items.name: rain-ride
items.text: carving through rain, a fine cone of spray lifting off the rear tire, the headlight beam cutting the mist

items.name: stationary-burnout
items.text: holding a stationary burnout, rear tire boiling smoke while the clamped front brake buries the forks

items.name: alpine-sweeper
items.text: mid-lean through an alpine sweeper, suspension loaded evenly, the valley dropping away beyond the guardrail
